Improved Imp.note: Pet talent: Imp's Firebolt and Fire Shield. Only matters with the Imp out.

Improved Voidwalker.note: Pet talent: only matters with the Voidwalker out.

Improved Sayaad.note: Pet talent: only matters with a Succubus or Incubus out.

Improved Felhunter.note: Pet talent: only matters with the Felhunter out.

Unholy Power.note: Pet talent: more damage from every demon.

Fel Vitality.note: Tougher demons and a bigger mana pool for you.

Master Demonologist.note: The bonus depends on the demon: Imp more Fire damage, Voidwalker less damage taken, Succubus more Shadow damage, Felhunter resistances. Pick the demon for the job.

Demonic Knowledge.note: Spell damage that grows with your level while a demon is out.

Demonic Pact.note: Combo: keep Demonic Sacrifice's buff and still summon another demon.

Soul Siphon.note: Combo: stack Corruption, Siphon Life and Bane of Agony first, then Drain Life, Drain Soul or Wrack.

Wrack.note: Channel that speeds up your Corruption, Siphon Life and Bane of Agony ticks while it runs.

Improved Life Tap.note: Resource loop: more mana per Life Tap.

Demonic Energies.note: Resource loop: your spell damage heals your demon; Life Tap gives it mana too.

Soul Harvest.note: Resource loop: Drain Soul kills boost mana regen.

Decimation.note: Execute phase: Shadow Bolt or Searing Pain under 35% health → faster Soul Fire.

Bane of Havoc.note: Multi-target: copies part of your damage onto a second enemy.

Demonic Embrace.note: More health, which Life Tap turns into mana.
